facts.text: The hotel's address is 249 Dongho-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul.
The hotel offers a jogging course along a forest path on Namsan.
facts.excerpt: Along a refreshing forest path, breathe in the verdant atmosphere of Namsan with every step

facts.text: The hotel has a Clé de Peau Beauté Spa.
After a spa treatment, guests can relax with signature tea in the spa's Resting Lounge, which overlooks Namsan.
facts.excerpt: After your treatment, relax with signature tea in the Resting Lounge overlooking Namsan’s four seasons.

facts.text: The hotel features a cultural experience at Leeum Museum of Art among its guest experiences.
